caption: A fire steel is scraped with a knife, and sparks shower onto a nest of dry tinder that begins to smoke and then flame.

sa.check: A fire steel is scraped with a knife over a nest of tinder.
The sparks land on the tinder.
Smoke rises from where they land.
A small flame follows the smoke.
Nothing burns before the sparks land.

pc.expect: The sparks fly downward from the steel onto the tinder below and go dark on the way or as they land, while the smoke and flame rise from the tinder.
pc.fail: The sparks rise from the steel and gather above it; or sparks hang in the air; or the smoke sinks and pools around the nest; or the flame points downward into the ground.

pc.expect: The sparks come only during the scrape, then smoke appears where they landed and a flame follows; the order does not reverse.
pc.fail: The smoke appears before any spark lands; or the flame appears before any smoke; or the sparks keep flying after the knife has stopped; or the charred tinder turns back to pale dry fibre.

pc.expect: The smoke and flame appear at the spot the sparks landed and not elsewhere.
pc.fail: The smoke rises from a part of the nest no spark reached; or the sparks land on the tinder and nothing smokes or catches at all to the end of the clip; or the flame appears in the air above the nest with a gap to the tinder; or the nest smokes while the sparks fly wide of it.

pc.expect: The tinder is a nest of fine dry fibres that glows, curls and blackens, and the steel and knife stay rigid.
pc.fail: The tinder melts and drips; or the fibres stay pale and straight while glowing; or the nest lifts as one solid block; or the knife bends as it scrapes.

pc.expect: One steel, one knife and one nest; the sparks come from the steel and the tinder chars rather than vanishing.
pc.fail: Sparks appear in the air far from the steel; or the nest vanishes at a stroke while still whole; or a second steel appears; or the knife passes through the steel.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The ground, the steel's handle and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The steel's handle changes colour; or the ground changes texture; or the background changes between frames.

note: Whoever scrapes the steel is not judged.
